modelNotes: Threes Board 1.0 uses season threes, last 5 threes, last 10 threes, three point attempts, attempt trend, expected minutes, minutes confidence, and usage.
Threes Board 2.0 adds minutes scaling, opponent three rank, pace, rest, teammate absence redistribution, volatility, and floor/ceiling ranges.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Wembanyama (back) is questionable for Wednesday's game in Portland.
injury.detail: Wembanyama sat out Monday's 123-107 win over the Kings due to a back issue, but it looks like he could be back in action Wednesday night. If he's cleared to return, Luke Kornet would head back to the second unit and Tarris Reed could drop from the rotation entirely.

injury.shortComment: Towns (knee) is questionable for Wednesday's game against Cleveland.
injury.detail: Towns is at risk of sitting out for the second time in New York's last three contests. Andre Drummond would be a plug-and-play fantasy option at center in most settings if Towns is ultimately unable to play Wednesday.

injury.shortComment: Smith (illness) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against the Hornets.
injury.detail: Smith has been a regular on the injury report recently due to a gastrointestinal illness, though he played in Chicago's last two outings, averaging 18.5 points, 5.0 rebounds, 2.5 assists and 2.0 combined steals-plus-blocks in 29.5 minutes per contest over that brief stretch. If the big man is unable to play Wednesday, Nic Claxton would likely enter the first unit.

injury.shortComment: Lendeborg is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Kings with an illness.
injury.detail: The standout rookie is in danger of sitting out for the first time all season. Georges Niang and Gui Santos would be in line for more playing time in the frontcourt if Lendeborg isn't feeling well enough to play.

injury.shortComment: Hart (shoulder) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against Cleveland.
injury.detail: Hart is dealing with a right shoulder sprain after dropping a triple-double in Sunday's win over Indiana. If the veteran wing joins OG Anunoby (calf) on the inactive list Wednesday, Mohamed Diawara and Pacome Dadiet would be candidates for an uptick in minutes.

injury.shortComment: Embiid (illness) is listed as doubtful for Wednesday's game versus Miami.
injury.detail: Embiid missed Monday's 128-111 loss to Portland and doesn't appear to be on track to return Wednesday against the Heat. As a result, Jabari Walker could make another start, with more minutes available for Adem Bona and Dominick Barlow.

injury.shortComment: Fox (shin) is questionable to play Wednesday's game against the Trail Blazers.
injury.detail: Fox sat out Monday's 123-107 win over Sacramento due to a right shin contusion, and he's now in danger of missing a second consecutive regular-season outing with the ailment. Stephon Castle will continue to see increased usage if Fox remains sidelined.

injury.shortComment: James is probable for Wednesday's game against the Bulls due to general soreness.
injury.detail: James is experiencing some soreness on the left side of his body, but he's expected to power through it Wednesday. James is averaging 5.8 points, 3.8 rebounds, 3.1 assists and 1.1 triples per game this season.

injury.shortComment: McBride (adductor) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game versus Cleveland.
injury.detail: McBride could miss a second straight game due to left adductor tightness, though he was able to participate in Tuesday's practice. If the 26-year-old guard remains sidelined, Tyler Kolek, Jose Alvarado and Pacome Dadiet would be candidates for increased playing time.

injury.shortComment: Antetokounmpo (groin) is questionable for Wednesday's game in Philadelphia.
injury.detail: Antetokounmpo missed Sunday's 123-113 win over the Thunder due to right groin tendinitis, but he was able to get through most of Tuesday's practice, so he's trending in the right direction. If he's cleared to return, Bobby Portis would likely head back to the second unit.

injury.shortComment: Kalkbrenner (hip) is doubtful to play Wednesday against the Bulls.
injury.detail: Kalkbrenner suffered the hip injury during Monday's 117-111 loss to the Bulls and is now in danger of missing Wednesday's game. If he's out, Hannes Steinbach will have a chance to get into the rotation.
